design.status_of_evidence: CONFIRMATORY replication of the C2 (HS-Stroke, discovery) EEGNet result on an independent cohort (Lee2019, 54 healthy participants); no EEGNet PMIS outcome on Lee2019 exists
design.model: R4/Paper A EEGNet-8,2 exactly as in C2 (kern 64 at 128 Hz, 100 epochs, batch 64, Adam 1e-3, max-norm, no tuning); input 20 channels x 512 (4-40 Hz trial-local causal Butterworth, MI window, 128 Hz), per-trial channel z-score
design.pairs: C3 pairs (lee2019.build_tasks); per task an outcome-blind random quarter, 10 of 40 (rng [7411, participant, run]); arms A, B, C, E (placebo) and one A/A per task; <= 48 arms per GPU group; CRN within pair as in C2
design.estimands: C2 formulas; 54 participants; t95 CI; Monte Carlo sign-flip (1e6, seed 7499); Holm over S1-S3 (S3 = EEGNet minus the C3a exact-optimum TS+LR d on the same pairs)
design.fail_closed: as C2 (non-finite output, A/A mismatch, missing group, commitment mismatch -> BLOCKED)

hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H1_primary: d_EEGNet on Lee2019 differs from 0; declared direction > 0; MC sign-flip over 54 participants
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H2_S3: d_EEGNet > d_TSLR (C3a exact-optimum TS+LR on the same pairs); tested as S3 within the Holm family
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H3_descriptive_declared: participant-level correlation of d_EEGNet with partner-arm BA is negative (post-hoc pattern of C3a TS+LR r = -0.96 and C2 EEGNet r = -0.60); reported with Pearson / Spearman, not Holm-adjusted
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold
